summary: Frontend-only testing of Lisa voice-command-driven UI via the command text box (Azure OFF). All 10 requested flows work: popup opens, command input/send enabled with avatar off, order filter commands (delivered / high priority + paid / find ORD-100), navigation to Items Search (popup persists across route), item filter commands (electronics + in stock, refurbished), pagination (next/previous), reset filters returns all 1,000 records, navigation back to Orders, and unknown chat command gracefully shows the 503 Foundry-not-configured message without crashing. Transcript updates for each command as expected.

issues: Lisa popup (bottom-right, ~w-96) overlaps the last column of the results table on smaller viewports; not a functional bug but obscures Amount/Date cells until scrolled or popup collapsed.

critical_code_review_comments: voiceCommands.parseCommand: 'find order ORD-100' produces search='ORD-100' matching 999/1000 records (order numbers start ORD-100xxx). Regex \bord[-\s]?(\d{3,})\b captures only 3+ digits — consider anchoring to full 6-digit ORD id or requiring exact match to avoid misleading UX when user says a partial id.

useSearch.applyCommand: when cmd.page is used, it runs against applied.current filters (good), but the transcript-driven flow after 'reset filters' followed by 'next page' works only because applied.current was reset synchronously; timing depends on state batching — currently OK but fragile.

LisaAvatar.handleUtterance: chat branch sets status='thinking' but on 503 the say() only pushes an assistant message (synthRef null when avatar off), which is fine; however error.response is not guaranteed on axios network errors — consider defensive check e?.response?.status.
voiceBus pending buffer: only stores one command per page; rapid double navigation+search could drop a command (edge case).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 validated backend at 100%. Iteration 2 validated Lisa voice-command UI end-to-end via lisa-text-input. Barge-in live-audio not testable without Azure; command box pipeline confirmed. No regressions.
